answer: Spectral Occupancy Attestation. Each operator must hold a licensed radio band and transmit a signed beacon whose phase drift is measured against a shared crystal reference; neighbors cross-check timing residuals and reject identities whose drift matches no independently licensed transmitter. A zephyr of ambient noise calibrates the check. Forging N identities requires N physical transmitters and N license fees, so an attacker pays full spectrum cost per identity. Only licensed operators form an oasis in the verified set.
